english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not needed or necessary.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not needed.
Use this when stressing that an item or action is not needed rather than that it is literally extra.

examples.english: It’s unnecessary to print all these documents.
examples.traditional: 呢啲文件冇必要全部打印出嚟。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 man4 gin6 mou5 bit1 jiu3 cyun4 bou6 daa2 jan3 ceot1 lei4

examples.english: Doing all these formalities is needless.
You do not need to buy flowers specially; it is superfluous.
examples.traditional: 你唔使特登買花，冇必要。
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 dak6 dang1 maai5 faa1 mou5 bit1 jiu3
